newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Silver Eagle buys electronics firm.
newsitem.headline: Silver Eagle buys electronics firm.

text.p: Consumer products maker Silver Eagle Holdings Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to buy electronics manufacturing concern Berne International Ltd from Sappire Pacific Ltd for HK$46 million.
Silver Eagle said it would fund the purchase through bank borrowings.
The deal is expected to be completed on January 17 and is conditional upon a due diligence review of Berne's assets, operations and financial condition, it added.

Berne holds a 100 percent stake in speaker manufacturer PB Zhuhai Electronics Ltd, a 55 percent interest in Shanghai Bai Li Electronics Co Ltd, which makes speakers and related products, and a 70 percent stake in transducers and adaptors maker Changzhou PB Electronic Co Ltd.
Silver Eagle said the deal was an opportunity to buy a profitable business which will strengthen its earnings base and diversify its business activities.
